purpose: Fail-closed Product Definition contract from allocated requirements and derived engineering inputs to characteristics, datum/measurement semantics, CAD binding, evidence, drawing and inspection. Drawing is a projection, never a second engineering authority.
principles: System/interface requirements are allocated before they become part-level responsibilities. Shared requirements retain explicit complementary allocation across participants.
Derived loads and calculated design inputs are separate objects from requirements and characteristics; equal numeric values do not imply common meaning or authority.
The product is defined before the drawing is authored. The drawing projects controlled Product Definition only.
Every manufacturing/inspection characteristic has a stable characteristic ID, revision/effectivity context and explicit authority source chain.
A nominal CAD value does not imply a released tolerance. OPEN remains OPEN and must not inherit a SOLIDWORKS/general-template default.

Datum/reference-system semantics and measurement conditions are first-class characteristic context. For thin/compliant parts, free/fixture state and measurement force are release-critical where they materially affect the result.
Inspection method/strategy is selected with the characteristic before release. A tolerance that cannot be verified with a controlled method/capability is not release-ready.
Manufacturing route/supplier capability is upstream of process-dependent tolerances, roughness and joining notes. Route selection is an engineering decision, not a drawing note.
Native PMI/DimXpert is the preferred semantic carrier for size/fit/GD&T. Other controlled native model annotations are allowed when DimXpert is not the correct carrier.
Semantic annotation existence is insufficient for release: characteristic-to-geometry binding invariance must meet the required qualification level.
Physical/behavior analysis and variation/tolerance/process-capability analysis are separate evidence classes with separate invalidation domains.
Downstream findings create explicit Engineering Feedback Records and reopen upstream decisions through change control; silent characteristic edits are prohibited.
Drawing/inspection code consumes compiled Product Definition/slices only; legacy candidate strings, UI defaults and PDF text are non-authorities.
Configuration/effectivity is explicit. Released predecessors remain immutable; changes create successor revisions and stale only applicable downstream consumers.

requires: all projected characteristics exist or are explicitly OPEN
all shown numeric values have source authority
legacy conflicting numeric candidate specs excluded
DRAWING_CANDIDATE_READY.allows: Design-review SLDDRW projection with controlled nominals and explicit OPEN states.

requires: controlled variation semantics for authored tolerance/fit/GD&T
PMI_AUTHORING_READY.allows: Author candidate native PMI/annotations; release still requires binding-invariance qualification.

requires: datum/reference systems and measurement conditions controlled
binding invariance PASS at required level
DRAWING_RELEASE_READY.allows: Promote released SLDDRW/PDF and inspection plan.

feedback_rule: Any downstream inability to manufacture, analyze, inspect or unambiguously project a characteristic creates an Engineering Feedback Record and reopens the relevant engineering decision/change record; no silent upstream mutation.
mutation_rule: Any method pivot or characteristic authority change atomically updates decision/change, next action, policy/architecture, dependency graph/relationship registry and acceptance tests before implementation.
non_authorities: runtime face index without semantic qualification
drawing_authoring_rule: S2 carries claim-level drawing_authoring targets. Annotation-view role and drawing-view role are controlled context; actual SOLIDWORKS annotation-view identity/orientation is D2/D3 evidence. Release-native drawing values never originate only in SLDDRW text.
general_tolerance_rule: No implicit general tolerance. If used, characteristic/drawing contract must reference a controlled general_tolerance_policy_ref.
